chansons.style: Modern country ballad, acoustic guitar, weeping steel guitar, gritty male vocal, deep storytelling heartbreak vibe, 95 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un homme découvre les lettres cachées de sa femme et réalise que son mariage n'était qu'un mensonge.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Acoustic picking, slow steel slide)

[Verse 1]
I found the letters hidden in the drawer
The ones you said you burned a year before
The ink was faded but the truth was clear
You’ve been loving him while I was working here

[Pre-Chorus]
I gave you my name, I gave you my soul
Now I’m staring at a half-empty hole

[Chorus]
There’s rust on the ring, there’s a crack in the gold
A beautiful lie that we both tried to hold
You packed up your secrets and left in the night
Leaving me with the shadows and a bottle of rye

[Verse 2]
The hound dog is whining, he misses your touch
I'm drinking a bottle of way too much
The porch light is buzzing, the screen door is torn
I'm left with the shadows and a heart that is worn

[Chorus]
There’s rust on the ring, there’s a crack in the gold
A beautiful lie that we both tried to hold
You packed up your secrets and left in the night
Leaving me with the shadows and a bottle of rye

[Bridge]
They say time is a healer, but time is a thief
It stole my tomorrow and left me the grief

[Chorus]
There’s rust on the ring, there’s a crack in the gold
A beautiful lie that we both tried to hold
You packed up your secrets and left in the night
Leaving me with the shadows and a bottle of rye

[Outro]
Yeah, a bottle of rye.
Just rust on the ring.
(Fade out with steel guitar)

chansons.style: Upbeat modern country, lively fiddle, banjo, bright acoustic strumming, cheerful female vocal, danceable party vibe, 118 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Après une longue semaine de travail, un couple se rend au saloon local pour danser jusqu'au lever du soleil.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Upbeat fiddle and banjo riff)

[Verse 1]
The work week is over, the tractor is parked
The sun’s going down and the evening is dark
Put on your best jeans and your dancing shoes
We’re heading down to the saloon for the blues

[Pre-Chorus]
The band is tuning up, the neon is bright
We ain’t going home till the morning light

[Chorus]
Keep your boots on the hardwood, spin me around
Let the fiddle play loud, let it shake up the ground
We’re dancing all night, till the rooster crows
Where the whiskey flows and the good time goes

[Verse 2]
The bartender’s smiling, he knows what we need
A couple of cold ones to water the seed
Of a memory we’ll talk about ten years from now
When the jukebox is playing and we’re taking a bow

[Chorus]
Keep your boots on the hardwood, spin me around
Let the fiddle play loud, let it shake up the ground
We’re dancing all night, till the rooster crows
Where the whiskey flows and the good time goes

[Bridge]
Don’t worry ‘bout the clock, don’t worry ‘bout the bill
Just keep on moving, let the music fill

[Chorus]
Keep your boots on the hardwood, spin me around
Let the fiddle play loud, let it shake up the ground
We’re dancing all night, till the rooster crows
Where the whiskey flows and the good time goes

[Outro]
Yeah, dancing all night!
(Fiddle solo fade out)

chansons.titre_fr: La poussière sur le tableau de bord
chansons.style: Mid-tempo modern country, gentle acoustic strumming, soft pedal steel, warm raspy male vocal, reflective nostalgic vibe, 92 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: En conduisant devant son ancien lycée, un homme réfléchit à la rapidité avec laquelle les années s'écoulent.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Slow acoustic strumming, soft pedal steel)

[Verse 1]
I drove past the high school today
The bleachers are rusted, the kids are away
It feels like a minute since I walked those halls
Now I’m reading the names on the memorial walls

[Pre-Chorus]
The seasons keep turning, the leaves turn to brown
And the fast-moving river keeps slowing me down

[Chorus]
There’s dust on the dashboard, miles on the tires
We’re burning through days like we’re walking through fires
The clock on the wall doesn’t ask for your permission
It just keeps on ticking, fulfilling its mission

[Verse 2]
My daddy’s old truck is parked in the shed
I still hear the echoes of the wise things he said
He told me that time is a bird on the wing
You can’t hold it close, you can’t make it sing

[Chorus]
There’s dust on the dashboard, miles on the tires
We’re burning through days like we’re walking through fires
The clock on the wall doesn’t ask for your permission
It just keeps on ticking, fulfilling its mission

[Bridge]
So I’ll hold you a little tighter tonight
Before the sun rises and steals away the light

[Chorus]
There’s dust on the dashboard, miles on the tires
We’re burning through days like we’re walking through fires
The clock on the wall doesn’t ask for your permission
It just keeps on ticking, fulfilling its mission

[Outro]
Just ticking away.
Dust on the dashboard.

chansons.style: Modern country ballad, fingerpicked acoustic, crying steel guitar, emotional female vocal, yearning long-distance vibe, 105 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Une femme exprime son amour et son impatience de retrouver son partenaire qui travaille loin de chez eux.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Gentle acoustic picking, distant steel guitar)

[Verse 1]
I’m watching the taillights fade in the rain
Counting the hours till I see you again
You’re three states away in a cheap motel
Working a job that you don’t even like well

[Pre-Chorus]
The signal is dropping, your voice is so low
But I'm holding on tight and I won't let you go

[Chorus]
Through highway lines and telephone wires
I’m sending my heart through the cold evening fires
The miles are just numbers, the map is a test
When I close my eyes, baby, you're in my chest

[Verse 2]
I made up the bed but I sleep on the edge
Keeping my promise, keeping my pledge
The calendar pages are falling like snow
But I got a secret that only you know

[Chorus]
Through highway lines and telephone wires
I’m sending my heart through the cold evening fires
The miles are just numbers, the map is a test
When I close my eyes, baby, you're in my chest

[Bridge]
One day the driving will finally be done
We’ll wake up together beneath the same sun

[Chorus]
Through highway lines and telephone wires
I’m sending my heart through the cold evening fires
The miles are just numbers, the map is a test
When I close my eyes, baby, you're in my chest

[Outro]
Right in my chest.
Wait for me, darling.

chansons.style: Upbeat modern country, lively banjo, mandolin, handclaps, energetic male vocal, youthful carefree summer vibe, 115 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un homme se remémore avec joie les étés de son enfance passés à jouer dans la nature sans aucun souci.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Banjo roll, upbeat mandolin, handclaps)

[Verse 1]
The screen door slammed and we didn’t look back
Running down the dirt road, off the beaten track
Mama yelled out that we better be home by dark
But we had a whole summer and a brand new spark

[Pre-Chorus]
Pockets full of nothing but lint and a dream
Living like kings of the muddy downstream

[Chorus]
We were barefoot in the creek, catching crawdads and sun
Didn’t have a worry, didn’t need to run
Just a couple of kids with the world at our feet
Making our own rhythm to the summer heat

[Verse 2]
We built a rope swing from the old willow tree
Jumping in the water, wild and free
Scraped up our knees but we didn’t even cry
Just wiped off the dirt and watched the eagle fly

[Chorus]
We were barefoot in the creek, catching crawdads and sun
Didn’t have a worry, didn’t need to run
Just a couple of kids with the world at our feet
Making our own rhythm to the summer heat

[Bridge]
Now I got a mortgage and a nine-to-five
But in my head, that old creek is still alive

[Chorus]
We were barefoot in the creek, catching crawdads and sun
Didn’t have a worry, didn’t need to run
Just a couple of kids with the world at our feet
Making our own rhythm to the summer heat

[Outro]
Yeah, the summer heat!
(Banjo fade out)

chansons.style: Mid-tempo modern country, warm acoustic guitar, subtle fiddle, comforting male vocal, hopeful healing and recovery vibe, 98 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Après une période difficile, un homme retrouve la paix intérieure en réparant sa maison et son jardin.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Warm acoustic strumming, soft fiddle)

[Verse 1]
The storm came through and it tore up the yard
Left the old oak broken and the living room scarred
I spent a long winter just staring at the wall
Waiting for the spring, waiting for the call

[Pre-Chorus]
But the frost is retreating, the green’s coming back
I’m finding my footing right here on the track

[Chorus]
I’m mending the fences, I’m painting the door
I’m sweeping the sorrow right off of the floor
It takes a little time to heal up the bone
But I’m learning to walk, and I’m walking alone

[Verse 2]
I planted some roses right where the weeds grew
Found a new rhythm in the morning dew
The ghosts of the past are just smoke in the breeze
I’m making my peace with the old willow trees

[Chorus]
I’m mending the fences, I’m painting the door
I’m sweeping the sorrow right off of the floor
It takes a little time to heal up the bone
But I’m learning to walk, and I’m walking alone

[Bridge]
Every nail that I hammer, every board that I lay
Is a step toward a brighter and a brand new day

[Chorus]
I’m mending the fences, I’m painting the door
I’m sweeping the sorrow right off of the floor
It takes a little time to heal up the bone
But I’m learning to walk, and I’m walking alone

[Outro]
Walking alone, but I’m walking strong.
Mending the fences.

chansons.style: Slow modern country ballad, gentle fingerpicking, weeping pedal steel, tender female vocal, emotional family tribute, 90 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Une femme rend un hommage touchant à ses grands-parents et à l'héritage d'amour simple qu'ils lui ont laissé.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Gentle fingerpicking, soft pedal steel sigh)

[Verse 1]
Grandpa’s hands were rough like the bark on the pine
He taught me to fish and to read every line
Grandma was humming while she baked up the bread
She tucked me in warmly and patted my head

[Pre-Chorus]
Their house smelled of cedar and old leather chairs
And the quiet devotion of a lifetime of prayers

[Chorus]
There’s silver in the picture frame, gold in their hearts
They built a foundation before we could start
Two roots in the soil, standing steady and tall
I hear their sweet voices whenever I call

[Verse 2]
He wore the same hat for a dozen long years
She kept every letter and wiped all my tears
They didn’t have money, but they had a dime
And a love that was richer than space and than time

[Chorus]
There’s silver in the picture frame, gold in their hearts
They built a foundation before we could start
Two roots in the soil, standing steady and tall
I hear their sweet voices whenever I call

[Bridge]
Now the farmhouse is quiet, the porch swing is still
But their legacy lives on the top of the hill

[Chorus]
There’s silver in the picture frame, gold in their hearts
They built a foundation before we could start
Two roots in the soil, standing steady and tall
I hear their sweet voices whenever I call

[Outro]
Whenever I call.
I love you both.

chansons.style: Somber modern country, sparse acoustic chords, mournful cello and steel, grieving male vocal, raw final goodbye vibe, 94 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un homme accompagne les derniers instants de sa bien-aimée à l'hôpital et lui fait ses adieux avec courage.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Sparse acoustic chords, mournful cello and steel)

[Verse 1]
The doctor walked in and he looked at the floor
Said there ain’t no use in fighting no more
I held your frail hand as the monitors sighed
Trying to be brave while I broke down and cried

[Pre-Chorus]
You gave me a smile and you whispered my name
Told me to live and keep tending the flame

[Chorus]
This is one last sunset, one last goodbye
Watching the colors fade out of the sky
You’re crossing the river, you’re heading up home
Leaving me here, but I'll never roam

[Verse 2]
I packed up your clothes and I folded your shawl
I stared at the shadows that danced on the wall
The house is too quiet, the bed is too wide
But I feel your spirit right here by my side

[Chorus]
This is one last sunset, one last goodbye
Watching the colors fade out of the sky
You’re crossing the river, you’re heading up home
Leaving me here, but I'll never roam

[Bridge]
They say heaven’s a place where the broken are mended
I know that your journey has finally ended

[Chorus]
This is one last sunset, one last goodbye
Watching the colors fade out of the sky
You’re crossing the river, you’re heading up home
Leaving me here, but I'll never roam

[Outro]
I'll never roam.
Goodbye, my darling.

chansons.style: Nostalgic modern country, warm acoustic strumming, lonely harmonica, wistful female vocal, childhood storytelling vibe, 100 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: De retour dans sa région natale, une femme repense avec nostalgie à la balançoire en pneu et à son enfance perdue.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Warm acoustic strumming, lonely harmonica)

[Verse 1]
I drove back to the county where the blacktop ends
Looking for the ghosts of my childhood friends
The woods are still thick but the trail is all gone
And the creek doesn’t sing like it did in the dawn

[Pre-Chorus]
I closed my eyes and I heard the old laughter
Echoing back from the long time after

[Chorus]
Take me back to the old tire swing
When the biggest mistake was a bee’s little sting
When the days were so long and the worries were few
And the sky was an endless and beautiful blue

[Verse 2]
The barn is collapsing, the paint’s peeling off
I remember the hayloft, the dust and the cough
We played until streetlights began to glow
With nowhere to be and nowhere to go

[Chorus]
Take me back to the old tire swing
When the biggest mistake was a bee’s little sting
When the days were so long and the worries were few
And the sky was an endless and beautiful blue

[Bridge]
You can’t buy a ticket to the days of your youth
But the memories linger and they tell you the truth

[Chorus]
Take me back to the old tire swing
When the biggest mistake was a bee’s little sting
When the days were so long and the worries were few
And the sky was an endless and beautiful blue

[Outro]
Beautiful blue.
Just a memory now.

chansons.style: Upbeat modern country, driving acoustic rhythm, electric guitar twang, friendly male duet, loyal brotherhood anthem, 110 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Deux amis d'enfance célèbrent leur fraternité indéfectible en réparant un porche et en partageant des bières.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Driving acoustic rhythm, electric guitar twang)

[Verse 1]
We met in the sandbox when we were just five
Trading our toy trucks just to feel alive
We survived the high school and the teenage parts
Never let the distance tear apart our hearts

[Pre-Chorus]
Through the thick and the thin, through the mud and the rain
You're the only brother that would share in my pain

[Chorus]
With rusty nails and cold beers, we’re building it up
Pouring out our souls in a tin camping cup
You got my back when the whole world falls
A loyal true friend when the duty calls

[Verse 2]
When my wife walked out and I hit the deep end
You brought over tools and you acted the friend
We fixed up the porch and we fixed up my pride
With a joke and a story and a long truck ride

[Chorus]
With rusty nails and cold beers, we’re building it up
Pouring out our souls in a tin camping cup
You got my back when the whole world falls
A loyal true friend when the duty calls

[Bridge]
Blood makes you family, but trust makes you kin
I’d do it all over, again and again

[Chorus]
With rusty nails and cold beers, we’re building it up
Pouring out our souls in a tin camping cup
You got my back when the whole world falls
A loyal true friend when the duty calls

[Outro]
When the duty calls!
Here’s to you, brother.
(Guitar twang fade out)
